verdict.rationale: Gram's docs describe pointing Claude Code, Cursor and Copilot at one hosted URL. The Control Plane generates and hosts servers from OpenAPI documents or TypeScript Functions, and it creates proxy endpoints in front of remote upstream MCP servers, so clients reach downstream tools through a platform-managed endpoint. The CLI also installs toolsets as MCP servers in agents. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that clients connect with no self-run infrastructure, and an explicit doc statement on transport and connection-URL setup for the hosted endpoints.
